# Onyx Executive Miami

> Owner-managed private chauffeur service across South Florida: Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach. Operated by Koretsky Logistics LLC. Miami-Dade for-hire permit #64666, commercially insured (certificate of insurance on request).

## Key facts

- Phone and WhatsApp: +1 786 931 6699 (+1 786 931 ONYX). Email: info@onyxexecmiami.com
- Vehicle: brand-new Chevrolet Suburban, up to 6 passengers.
- Hourly rate: $100 per hour, 3 hour minimum, up to 12 hours. From 6 hours the whole booking is $80 per hour. A round trip takes 20% off the return ride.
- Airport and point-to-point rides: fixed fare shown by the instant quote and confirmed in writing before the ride. Fuel and tolls on hourly bookings are included.
- Airports: 60 minutes of free waiting time, flight tracking, meet and greet.
- Languages spoken: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish. The website is available in English, Spanish and Russian.
- Google rating: 5.0 from 9 reviews.

- [Airport transfers](https://onyxexecmiami.com/airport-transfers.html): MIA, FLL, Palm Beach, Opa-locka
